description: A single glassy wing, veined like a leaf. Whatever hatched it is bigger than anything you want to meet.
lore: Oiled and set in a frame it makes the cheapest window in the country and a better one than glass: it will not yellow, it will not craze, and it takes a knock. Half the lanterns on the east road are looking out through one. It is not an [[monsters/butterfly_dragon|Emberwing]]'s — those are scaled, and they burn. Every lantern-maker on that road can give you the span of the animal to the inch, off the taper of the veins, and not one of them has laid eyes on it.
gm_notes: Negative evidence: a trade that has measured a flier it has never met, and glazes its lamps with it. Keep the animal off-screen.
